subject: Post-POC recap and 10-min quote / blurb request
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Anna Chen <anna@clearops.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-POC recap and 10-min quote / blurb request

Hi Anna —

Thanks again for running the pilot with us last month. Quick recap from our side on the production-style test we ran against the RW-large-v1 configuration: 

- Latency (p95) improved from ~420ms to ~295ms (≈30% faster) under your typical traffic pattern.
- Cost per inference (token-normalized) reduced ~45% after enabling prefix caching + batching.
- Error/timeout rate dropped to 0.4% from 1.1% (fewer retries needed).
- Request throughput hit the committed burst target during the high-surge window without degradation.

I attached the one-page results summary (clearops_poc_results.pdf) and the short dashboard link above. All signs point to a pretty successful POC.

Two quick asks if you're willing:
1) Would ClearOps be open to a one- or two-sentence quote we can use in a short customer spotlight? Something like: 

  "Redwood Inference helped us reduce inference costs by ~45% and deliver faster responses for our customers with no engineering overhead."

  — we can provide a suggested blurb if helpful.

2) If you prefer to say this on a short call, could we lock 10 minutes next week to capture a line or two on record and confirm attribution (name/title)?

If yes, I can send a calendar invite — proposed times: Thu, Nov 5 at 9:00 AM PT or Thu, Nov 5 at 4:00 PM PT.

Thanks, and happy to tweak wording to what you’re comfortable with.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0191

Attachments: clearops_poc_results.pdf

Hi Lauren —

Really great work on the analysis and thanks for the clear summary. The numbers look consistent with our internal dashboards; the only small tweak I’d ask is to soften the cost reduction to "~45%" rather than a hard 48% in any public-facing line (we prefer approximate figures).

We’re happy to provide a short blurb and to be quoted. If you want to draft something short, send it over and I’ll approve or edit.

I can do the 10-minute call on Thu Nov 5 at 9:00 AM PT. If possible, keep it off the record for any technical details — the blurb/attribution is fine.

Anna Chen
Head of ML — ClearOps
anna@clearops.io | +1 (206) 555-0123

Perfect — appreciate the guidance. Quick draft blurb below; feel free to edit freely: 

"Redwood Inference reduced our inference unit cost by ~45% and improved median response time, enabling us to deliver lower-cost features to customers without extra infra work."

If that looks good I’ll include your name and title as: Anna Chen, Head of ML, ClearOps.

I’ve booked the 10-min slot for Thu Nov 5, 9:00 AM PT on a provisional basis — invitation to follow. On the call we’ll read the approved 1–2 sentence quote back for sign-off and capture a 10–15s soundbite if you’re comfortable.

FWIW: I attached the one-pager again and the HubSpot link for the deal.

Thanks —
Lauren
